HandSorting.name: Hand Sorting and Visibility
HandSorting.label: Configure Hand
HandSorting.hint: Choose visible card types and their order, separately for characters and NPCs. Saved per client.
HandSorting.instructions: Drag rows or use the arrows to change the order. Check the card types to show. Changes apply when you save.

HandView.label: Displayed Character Cards
HandView.hint: Choose the cards shown in the hand. Prepare vault cards and equip items through their original documents.

LockPosition.label: Lock Hand Position
LockPosition.hint: In Free positioning mode, hold Alt and drag a card to move the whole hand. Enable this setting to lock the position.

DeckCurvature.label: Hand Curvature (%)
DeckCurvature.hint: Adjust the curve and rotation of the card fan. 0 is flat, 100 is the original curve, 200 doubles it. Applies to the Curved deck style.

FrontPosition.label: Front Card Position
FrontPosition.hint: Choose whether the first, middle, or last card is displayed in front of the others.

CardOverlap.label: Card Overlap
CardOverlap.hint: Adjust how much the cards overlap each other. Default 55.

StyleResource.label: Resource Style
StyleResource.hint: Choose resources should get a label, an icon or nothing.

DeckPosition.label: Deck Position
DeckPosition.hint: Choose where the deck you be displayed.

DeckBorderMargin.label: Border Margin
DeckBorderMargin.hint: Space between the border and the deck. Only for Left & Right Deck Position.

DeckBottomMargin.label: Bottom Margin
DeckBottomMargin.hint: Space between the bottom and the deck.

PlayerToken.label: Use Character Token
PlayerToken.hint: Display Character Token picture instead of portrait.

TTRpgCards.label: TTRPG Cards
TTRpgCards.hint: Simulate cards like the TTRPG version.

HideDescription.label: Hide Card description
HideDescription.hint: Hide card description but keep features & actions.

CardGradient.label: Card Gradient Fade
CardGradient.hint: Fade partially cards when not hovered. 0 to disable the fade.

InvertGradient.label: Invert Card Gradient Fade
InvertGradient.hint: Fade cards from bottom to top.

HoverY.label: Card Hover movement
HoverY.hint: Control how much card top slides when hovered.

HoverScale.label: Card Hover scale
HoverScale.hint: Control how much a card scales up when hover enlargement is enabled. 1 keeps its original size.

HoverScaleEnabled.label: Enlarge Cards on Hover
HoverScaleEnabled.hint: Enable card enlargement when the pointer is over a card.

AutoHide.label: Auto Collapse Hand
AutoHide.hint: Slide the hand after the pointer leaves the cards. Hover a visible part of a card to restore the hand.

AutoHideDelay.label: Auto Collapse Delay (seconds)
AutoHideDelay.hint: Time without hovering a card before the hand slides. Selected cards and dragging keep it expanded.

AutoHideDistance.label: Auto Collapse Distance (pixels)
AutoHideDistance.hint: Exact vertical offset of the collapsed hand in pixels. Positive values move cards down; negative values move them up. Leave part of a card visible to reopen the hand by hovering.

CardTheme.label: Card Theme
CardTheme.hint: Choose card colors. Auto follows the Foundry interface theme.

DragToPlay.label: Drag Cards to Play
DragToPlay.hint: Drag a card out of the hand and release it over the game canvas to use its action. Escape or dropping over the interface returns it to the hand. Vault and unequipped cards must be readied first.

SelectedCardScale.label: Selected Card Scale
SelectedCardScale.hint: Control how much card size increases when selected.

action.desc: Make a Spellcast Roll to connect with your companion and command them to take action. Spend a Hope to add an applicable Companion Experience to the roll. On a success with Hope, if your next action builds on their success, you gain advantage on the roll.

GENERAL.DragToPlay: Release to play · Escape to cancel

ERRORS.NoUse: No Action or Feature attached to this card.
ERRORS.PlayCard: Could not use this card. See the console for details.
